content: Pull my recent activities and give me a plan for the weekend.

Your recent riding was **90min endurance (Load 55)** and **2hr tempo (Load 85)**. Current **Fitness 55, Fatigue 48, Form +7**, with stable resting HR/HRV and ~7.5hr sleep, supports one longer aerobic ride plus one controlled quality session.

### Saturday — Endurance, 90min
Warmup: 10min at 50–65% FTP  
Main: 70min Z2 at 60–72% FTP, cadence 85–95rpm  
Cooldown: 10min below 55% FTP  
Estimated: **Intensity 0.65–0.70, Load 60–70**  
Why: Builds aerobic volume without creating excessive weekend fatigue.

### Sunday — Sweet spot, 60min
Warmup: 15min progressive at 50–70% FTP  
Main: 3×10min at 88–94% FTP, 4min below 55% FTP between  
Cooldown: 7min below 55% FTP  
Estimated: **Intensity 0.78–0.82, Load 60–70**  
Why: Adds a productive FTP-focused stimulus while keeping the workload controlled.

If Sunday legs feel heavy or resting HR is noticeably elevated, replace the intervals with 45–60min easy Z2.
